title: Ctrl All
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Ctrl All, after the Analog Rytm mod: hold TRK and press YES to turn CTRL ALL on or off (ALL shows in the top-right corner). While it is on, a parameter lock you set with a knob (hold a trig, turn a knob) is also set on the same step of every other track that has a trig there: the other audio tracks from an audio track, the other MIDI tracks from a MIDI track. Only knob turns are copied, never pastes, clears or CREATE RANDOM LOCKS.
